dek.text: Soluna and Applied Digital plan a joint AI data center on land across the road from the Briscoe Wind Farm's substation. Closing waits on a Briscoe County tax abatement.

introduction.text: [Soluna Holdings announced on {{date:c1}} a definitive agreement to form a jointly owned company with Applied Digital](c1). [That company is to develop a planned {{number:c2}} MW critical IT data center for AI and high performance computing at Project Dorothy 3, Soluna's development site near Silverton in Briscoe County](c2). [Soluna says Applied is expected to hold {{number:c3}}% of the company after closing and Soluna the remaining {{number:c3:1}}%](c3).

[Closing depends on conditions that include approval of a tax abatement for the project in Briscoe County](c4). [Soluna expects the transactions to close by the end of the calendar year](c5). The deal is a company's account of its own plan. No county action on the abatement is part of the record here.

sections.heading: A load built beside its generator

paragraphs.text: [Soluna describes Briscoe Wind as a {{number:c6}} MW wind farm in Briscoe County and Dorothy 3 as a planned AI data center beside it](c6). [It describes the existing Project Dorothy campus as {{number:c12}} MW, built behind the meter at the same wind farm, which it says it acquired in April](c12). [In its September release it said the two Dorothy sites already running account for {{number:c13}} MW of energized capacity](c13).

[Soluna's chief executive, John Belizaire, said the company was built "to bring load to the generation" so the power would be ready when demand arrived](c10). [He said the constraint in AI is energy access rather than chips](c11). Behind the meter means the campus draws on the wind farm's own output before that power reaches the grid's wires.

[Soluna announced on {{date:c18}} that it had closed the purchase of {{number:c18}} acres in Briscoe County](c18). [It says the land will host Dorothy 3, which it describes as a planned campus with potential capacity of up to {{number:c19}} MW](c19). [The company says the wind farm's substation sits directly across from the property, which it says positions Dorothy 3 for behind the meter access to generation it owns outright](c20).

[Soluna says the {{number:c21}} acres exceed the {{number:c21:1}} acres it first identified for the campus, and that the extra land leaves room for more data halls if further generation or storage becomes available](c21). [The first phase of Dorothy 3 is the {{number:c7}} MW in the new deal, and Soluna expects it to draw power from both Briscoe Wind and the grid, subject to definitive documentation](c7). The release does not say how that load would be split between the two.

sections.heading: What is signed and what is not

paragraphs.text: [ChronoScale, a publicly traded company majority owned by Applied, has signed a non-binding letter of intent to lease the planned facility](c8). [Soluna states there is no assurance a definitive lease will be signed on those terms or at all](c9). So the record holds a definitive agreement to form the company, a non-binding intent to lease and a condition still open in the county.

[The Public Notices page on the Briscoe County website lists a document titled Tax Abatement Guidelines and Criteria beside its Commissioners Court agendas](c22). [Soluna names approval of the abatement as a condition of closing](c4). The release does not say which county body would vote or when, and no agenda item for this project was found in the material checked for this account.
